MovieScript: On a bright, sun-baked street, Saul is driving a severely battered yellow compact car with one mismatched red door. Suddenly, a teenage skateboarder flies through the air and smashes heavily onto the car's windshield, instantly shattering the glass. The teen rolls onto the hot asphalt, clutching his leg and screaming, "My leg! You broke my leg!" while his friend rushes over with a smartphone to record the extortion attempt. Instead of panicking, Saul storms out of the car in a fit of absolute rage. Instantly seeing through the cheap hustle, he aggressively walks over and kicks the supposedly broken knee of the wailing teenager. His face twisted in mockery, Saul yells, "Zero point zero for choice of victim! I'm a lawyer!" Terrified by this unhinged older man who refuses to play the victim, the two scammer kids drop their act entirely. They scramble to their feet, grab their skateboards, and sprint away in sheer panic. Saul stands next to his shattered clunker, angrily pointing at their retreating backs and shouting, "I'll take a check!"
